products.sourceDescription:
Aero – a pneumatic desk. As simple as that! Independent from power sockets and cables Wide range of height adjustment: 765-1150 mm Rich palette of table top colours Quick and easy assembly Agile and fully mobile solution Organic Board for table top available as an option

Aero is a one-column, sit-stand solution that matches multiple work landscapes. It's ideal for agile spaces dedicated to creative meetings and seminar rooms, but it also perfectly supports spots where you need a moment of focused work.

Adjust the height of your Aero desk using the lever placed in the right corner of the table top. Just press it to raise the desk. To decrease the height, use the lever and push the table top downward by the other hand. See? The pneumatic lift even encourages micro-exercises during the day. Another unexpected benefit of having Aero!

This small pneumatic desk follows the concept of a dynamic workstation that easily adapts to modern offices as well as co-working hubs, where people rent a spot to work when needed and maintain balance by socialising with others who work remotly.

Need a moment to deeply focus on a task? Aero perfectly supports such focus rooms away from open space. It’s also a great fit for a home office when a regular, space-consuming desk isn’t an option.

Aero - greener than it looks Aero comes with the option of a table top made from the Organic Board - a material with proven green advantages: - chipboard made from 100% recycled wood bonded exclusively with bio-based, health-friendly, formaldehyde-free Organic Glue - elegant, durable melamine finish on both sides available in three colours: white, grey and oak - certified with Blue Angel, PEFC and Émissions dans l'air intérieur - easy to clean and care Organic Board is the aware choice, perfect if you care about the planet and your own wellbeing. Just the natural option to go for.

products.sourceDescription:
Guarantee of comfort and ergonomics Aimo swivel chair was designed with everyday comfort in mind. It combines timeless form with functionality, supporting concentration both in the office and at home. Choosing Aimo means choosing a reliable seating solution with an elegant finish. Two models to choose from – with or without a headrest Lumbar support that can be adjusted in height and depth and tilt angle Mesh backrest Comfortable, upholstered seat Backrest recline mechanism with 3 recline positions – from fully reclined to upright Adjustable backrest height and seat depth (to fit your height) Universal black colour Adjustable armrest height Multifunctional castors with an automatic braking mechanism Anti-Shock function

The ability to adjust the seat depth, as well as the height of the backrest and the chair itself, ensures an ergonomic sitting position regardless of body shape. Three-way adjustment of the lumbar support (for height, depth and angle) allows precise adaptation to the body shape and reduces back tension. The upholstered seat and multi-purpose castors with an automatic braking mechanism make it easy to take a safe and comfortable position at your desk.

Thanks to the three-position backrest lock, it is easy to switch from a posture requiring concentration to a more relaxed one. This prevents the chair from leaning back too much or being too stiff. The settings include a stable upright position, an intermediate one and full freedom of movement. In a fully reclined position using a knob, the user can adjust the amount of pressure required to recline the backrest.

Model with a headrest

A comfortable headrest made from the same breathable mesh as the backrest ensures a coherent look and a high level of comfort, providing necessary support. By adjusting the height and angle, the user can position the headrest to suit their needs. The 4D armrests offer a wide range of settings–including armrest height, as well as rotation of the armrest pad and its movement forwards and backwards, and left and right. These features help to reduce tension in the upper body. 4D armrests are available only in model with a headrest.

products.description: Airi – darbo kėdės iš SOHOS by Nowy Styl asortimento. Modelio variantą ir apdailą galite pasirinkti pagal gamintojo pavyzdines konfigūracijas. Dėl konkrečios komplektacijos ir kainos pateikite užklausą.
products.sourceDescription:
Designed for the rhythm of modern work - whether in a hybrid office, a bustling coworking space, or a quiet home office - Airi represents simplicity and comfort. The defining feature of this model is the “full mesh” experience. With breathable mesh applied to both the seat and the backrest, excellent airflow and thermal comfort are ensured throughout the entire workday. The integrated mechanism allows the chair to follow natural movements smoothly, offering the freedom to rock back for a moment of relaxation or to lock the backrest in a focused working position. With an ergonomic profile that naturally supports the spine and a minimalist, clean aesthetic, Airi serves as a stylish addition to any interior. Monochromatic design: Base, mesh, frame, and armrests all share a single, unified colour. Ergonomic support: Contoured mesh backrest for spinal health. Tilt mechanism: Allows for smooth reclining and a relaxing rocking function. Height adjustment Comfortable armrests

Colour reimagined Airi takes a monochromatic approach to design. The colour of the five-star base is perfectly matched to the mesh, frame and armrests, creating a seamless, uniform look. This makes the chair more than just a tool - it becomes a stylish accent piece for the workspace. Whether in a vibrant shade to boost energy or a muted tone for classic elegance, the chair adds character to the environment.

The mesh that breathes Breathable mesh is used on both the backrest and the seat. This choice ensures long-lasting comfort and prevents overheating, even during many hours at the desk. Beyond temperature control, the tension of the mesh backrest adapts naturally to the curve of the spine, providing tailored support.

Tilt mechanism The integrated Tilt mechanism allows for smooth and effortless adjustment of the recline angle. This feature gives the freedom to rock gently in the chair, adapting the position precisely to current needs. It is a solution that offers comfort, whether during intensive work or a moment of rest.

Armrests for enhanced comfort The integrated armrests deliver consistently stable support, and their unique shape has been meticulously engineered. This careful design ensures the armrests perfectly align with the natural resting position of your arms, guaranteeing a high level of convenience and exceptional comfort during use.

products.sourceDescription:
Aplo. Apply your concept Every space requires different options. The Aplo shelving system is a smart, modular line that empowers you to design your own furniture for your office. By combining open shelves with storage units, felt panels, flowerpots and accessories, you can create a functional office environment that truly reflects individual needs and preferences. Designer RainlightSTUDIO Flexible and modular design Multiple filling options: cabinets, shelves, lockers, drawers or even flower pots Felt U-shaped panels for shelves for a warmer, cosier look Wide palette of melamine, metal and felt finishes Perfect solution for storing, decorating and dividing spaces

CLICK SYSTEM The technology of fixing crossbars to the frame clicks together in seconds which makes assembly quick, easy and fully reversible. That allows to change Aplo layout at any time. The solution is currently patent pending.

RANGE OF MODULES Each Aplo element is available in two widths: 360 mm and 760 mm, allowing columns of different width (400 and 800 mm) to be mixed and matched to create layouts that are both highly functional and visually appealing. Hinged-door cabinets and lockers are available in heights of 1, 2, and 3 OH, providing enough space for documents and other items that need to be neatly stored out of sight. Other storage elements, such as open cabinets and drawers, are available in a single height of 1 OH. The flowerpot occupies one full unit of 1 OH, however, the container itself is only 0,5 OH in height. The remaining half of the unit is intended for the plant growth.

SHELF • serves as the basic unit that forms Aplo system • can be placed on any level from 1 to 6 • each shelf can be fitted with a U-shaped felt panel • shelves on levels 5 and 6 are equipped with a plastic profile for hanging a whiteboard OPEN CABINET • storage boxes without fronts • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 DRAWERS • fitted with horizontal metal handles • can be placed on level 1 or 2 LOCKER CABINET • fitted with a lock and horizontal metal handle • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 • if the locker’s height is 3 OH, it occupies levels 1-2-3 or 2-3-4 HINGED-DOOR CABINET • fitted with vertical metal handle, no lock • can be placed on levels from 1 to 4 • cabinets of height 2 and 3 OH are equipped with internal shelf • if the cabinet’s height is 3 OH it occupies levels 1-2-3 or 2-3-4 FLOWERPOT • fitted with plastic inserts • can be placed on any level from 1 to 6

USEFUL HINT Elements with a carcass: open cabinets, drawers, lockers and hinged-door cabinets, must not be positioned directly one above another. At least one empty space is required between them.

Need help configuring Aplo? Click the button below to access additional resources. Aplo Guide

Accessories - use them to shape Aplo your way!

Connect two Aplo sets together in one layout by use of: • 90° corner shelves that create angular composition. Corner shelves are available in 3 shapes: square, slanted, rounded • rectangular shelves to create linear layouts Both types of connecting shelves can join two Aplo sets of the same or different heights. Turn Aplo into a functional wardrobe module with a rail: • fixed directly to the shelf • suitable for 800 mm columns

Aplo cabinets build a cosy, semi-private workspace. Equipped with a whiteboard or felt back panel, they become less transparent yet even more functional by supporting everyday collaboration without losing their open character.

Felt back panel • tool-free assembly • applicable to columns of 400 and 800 mm width • felt back panel can be fitted only if the Aplo cabinet contains 2, 3 or 4 shelves placed directly one under another in one column Whiteboard • possible to hang only on shelf with plastic profile, placed on level 5 or 6 • applicable to columns of 800 mm width

Aplo is a solution that can but doesn’t need to stand against the wall. Its double-sided layout turns it into a decorative highlight, looking great from every perspective. The high variants of Aplo are best to use as room partition without loosing the feel of a common space. Due to Aplo's remarkable stability, it is a safe free standing furniture solution.

Designer spotlight RainlightSTUDIO Yorgo Lykouria is an award-winning designer and the founder of Rainlight Studio, a renowned multi-disciplinary design studio based in London. For more than 20 years Yorgo has created artefacts that inspire people to live imaginatively and courageously in the present. With an extensive career in architecture, interiors and industrial design - across continents and cultures - Yorgo brings an expansive, holistic perspective to any design challenge. Yorgo has gained international recognition for his innovative and human-centric approach to design, creating spaces and artefacts that blend beauty, functionality, and sustainability.

"Aplo is a system that allows to modulate space with various functional components. The screening elements bring not only a sense of colour and the visual accent but also privacy to the work experience. Aplo, with its reduced visual, brings structural clarity to your ecosystem and makes your space your very own." - designer of Aplo, Yorgo Lykouria

Cabinets with doors, drawers, and lockers let you hide belongings you want to keep safe and out of sight. Shelves, on the other hand, showcase beautiful items that decorate and warm up the room. The metal frame and melamine-faced fronts are perfectly flush, which creates a clean and elegant look of the whole piece of furniture.

ECO DESIGN The Aplo line is developed in accordance with the ecodesign management principles of the ISO 14006:2020 standard. As a result, Aplo achieves good environmental performance: - 25–30% of its total material content is recycled - over 90% of the product is recyclable

products.sourceDescription:
In 1968, when the paths of the great designer Luigi Colani and the innovation-oriented manufacturer Kusch+Co crossed, the Colani collection – embracing both the armchair and the chaise longue – was brought to life. That very special connection gave rise to a design classic that gained worldwide acclaim and still wins the hearts of open-minded people today.

Definition of modern cosiness

The iconic Colani soft seating collection is recognized for its ergonomic design and exceptional comfort. Appealing with its unique organic form, Colani still holds the same fascination today as it did back then. The fluid lines, highlighted by bold colours, create a vibrant atmosphere in spaces that long to captivate at first sight.

Colani collection blurs the boundary between furniture and art Gaining worldwide recognition, this iconic furniture has proven to be a perfect fit especially for relaxation areas, lobbies and lounge zones – including those at airports. Its vibrant, flowing, organic lines provide a remarkable contrast to contemporary glass, steel, and concrete structures. Colani collection blurs the boundary between furniture and art

Designer spotlight Luigi Colani Prof. Luigi Colani, born in 1928, initially studied sculpture and painting at the Berlin University of the Arts in Berlin, before he completed his studies in Aerodynamics at the Sorbonne, the former University of Paris. Subsequently, he emigrated to California where he headed the materials research department. In the 1950s, Colani returned to Europa, and created his idiosyncratic, aerodynamic and biomorph designs for automotive manufacturers.At the end of the 1960s, he held a tenure at Kusch+Co, developing a range of creative seating series. In the early 1990s, he moved to Asia, and began commuting between his atelier in Karlsruhe and countries such as China or Japan, the cradle of some of his most famous successes. Until his demise in September 2019, this acclaimed designer operated on a global level.

products.sourceDescription:
Elegant and modern, while staying flexible and practical

We all like to have a choice. Arranging a space tailored to the customer's specific needs should be offered as standard. The CX 3200 table system is more than just standard. The solution it offers makes rearranging a conference or training room amazingly simple. The diversity of solutions and combinations within the system may be surprising. Thanks to its flexibility, the system can keep up with any dynamically changing situation.

1 / 2 Leg type The CX 3200 system offers two types of legs: far-out legs and set-back legs. Arranging with set-back legs allows us to place more chairs at a given table. An arrangement with far-out legs, on the other hand, will provide the maximum available seating space at the table and thus increase seating comfort during a meeting. Modular horizontal wire trunking and a vertical wire trunking unit fixed to the leg will organise and hide any amount of cabling to create comfortable and aesthetically pleasing working conditions. eUP Prime Dynamic state of mind Wide range of height adjustment Rich palette of colours and patterns for table tops Lots of table top dimensions, including cost-effective 1350x650 mm size Panels, media ports and wire trunkings to build fully equipped workstation Control panel with display and memory of 3 positions Quick and easy assembly

eUP Prime is a new generation of well-known and valued eUP desks. It combines the best features of the well-known eUP2, eUP3 and eUP3 PRO models into one solution. While all existing eUP models will remain available, eUP Prime stands out with its attractive price level.

Our mindset is like our products - constantly evolving, adaptable and responsive to change. Being open to new ideas, learning and shifting perspectives result in releasing products like eUP Prime which gathers most valuable features and functions, staying within reach at the same time.

Choosing eUP Prime makes the office or any other working area flexible and powerful. Why is that? The eUP Prime is an investment in your independency, being ready to adapt effortlessly to different preferences. eUP Prime's nature is dynamic.

eUP Prime keeps your office flexible Your team can change in time but eUP Prime will always be the answer as it can follow the users' needs. Thanks to electric height adjustment and lots of accessories to be equipped with, eUP Prime suits everyone.

eUP Prime 2S Height adjustment range - 2-segment columns: 720–1220 mm (19 mm table top) 726–1226 mm (25 mm table top) eUP Prime 3S Height adjustment range - 3-segment columns 644–1294 mm (19 mm table top) 650–1300 mm (25 mm table top)

Control panel with display and memory of three positions

eUP Prime - greener than it looks eUP Prime now comes with the option of a table top made from the Organic Board - a material with proven green advantages: - chipboard made from 100% recycled wood bonded exclusively with bio-based, health-friendly, formaldehyde-free Organic Glue - elegant, durable melamine finish on both sides available in three colours: white, grey and oak - certified with Blue Angel, PEFC and Émissions dans l'air intérieur - easy to clean and care Organic Board is the aware choice, perfect if you care about the planet and your own wellbeing. Just the natural option to go for.

Sileo Evo panels featuring Class A sound absorption are the perfect complement to the eUP Prime line. Minimalist in design, acoustically efficient and exceptionally lightweight, they create a natural barrier against office noise, improving focus and privacy during daily tasks. Together, eUP Prime and Sileo Evo offer an ideal blend of ergonomic support and acoustic comfort. Sileo Evo

products.sourceDescription:
The Flesco conference chair combines modern design with functionality. Its name comes from the Italian word “flessibile”, which means flexibility and resilience. The chair is designed for dynamic office spaces where both comfort and aesthetics matter. Flesco stands out for its versatility, adapting perfectly to the different needs of its users and ensuring comfort even during long meetings. The ergonomic design and carefully selected materials guarantee full support and comfort during conferences, training sessions or business meetings. Design Oscar Buffon Ergonomic, versatile chair line High or low backrest Comfortable and durable seat Optional side drops of seat and backrest Open or closed armrests with pads Stackable up to 4 pieces Stable base on four legs or cantilever frame Three base options: four-leg, sled or swivel

Designed for comfort, crafted for connection

"We have created a chair line that combines essentiality, functionality, and versatility, with a clean, minimalist design that stands the test of time and seamlessly adapts to any living or work environment. Every component has been designed to be interchangeable, offering the customer complete personalization with many configuration possibilities." Oscar Buffon Designer

Flesco - customisation in every detail The Flesco conference chair is distinguished by the option to personalise the side drops of the seat and backrest. You can choose them in the same material as the seat (with an optional color variation) or opt for the modern Runner 3D fabric. This is the ideal solution for those who value aesthetics and individual style.

1 / 4 Flesco – a versatile chair for any space The Flesco conference chair is a versatile solution that fits seamlessly into a variety of interiors – from training and conference rooms to office spaces and reception areas, as well as waiting rooms in medical centres. Its elegant design and customisable features allow it to suit any interior arrangement. It’s also a perfect addition to coworking spaces, libraries and reading rooms, offering outstanding comfort and aesthetics. Flesco is the ideal combination of functionality and modern style. products.sourceDescription:
The all-rounder among the multi-purpose chairs. Ideally suited for a plethora of environments, ranging from foyers and canteens to conference and seminar rooms, not forgetting large assembly halls.

¡Hola! chair The dynamically shaped back is strongly reminiscent of a sail. Either with or without armrests, upholstered or unupholstered – the ergonomically shaped seat and back part invite everyone to take a seat. The fresh colours, which can be mixed and matched for the seat and backrest, add vitality to any room. The armrests are in the same colour as the backrest or the seat. This model of the ¡Hola! chair can be optionally equipped with castors. The ¡Hola! chair is stackable – the standard version up to 8 units, with upholstered pads up to 7.

”At that time, I didn’t realize that a sail could be an inspiration for the chair. I am happy with how ¡Hola! has now evolved. I remember Dieter Kusch saying feel free with the form that could be timeless and maybe could be like a sail. We went through with this, we prepared the drawings, the first sketches, made a model in the workshop and everything was finished. We have to think how this line is going to evolve in the future. I think it could last 20 years and more, and stay forever young.” Jorge Pensi designer

Relax with ¡Hola! Outdoor ¡Hola! Outdoor is suitable for outdoor use. The mechanical properties of the plastic parts are not affected by weather conditions. The four legs are made of powder-coated steel with an additional protective layer. Available with or without armrests. Relax with ¡Hola! Outdoor

products.sourceDescription:
Every model of K42 is focused both on functionality and design. Depending on space and particular needs, the K42 units can transform each square meter into a highly functional area. The cabinets line really stands out for its adaptable design.

Open or closed? Your room, your choice. - Cabinet with hinged doors and integrated flowerpot casing – units ready to make offices more plant-friendly, with no need to buy matching flower pots - Open cabinets – easy access and showcasing items you want to keep uncovered - Tambour door cabinets – horizontal opening with a light, modern look

Sliding door for sleek look The most functional solution for narrow spaces where opening hinged doors is not the most optimal choice. For an even cleaner and more seamless look, standard metal handles can be replaced with discreet plastic grip profiles.

A classy and reliable way to keep things in order - Hinged door cabinets – a traditional and practical solution - Drawer cabinets – for storing small items and personal accessories - Filing cabinet – designed to keep documents suspended on rails for perfect order and easy browsing

Expand your layout with upper cabinets for exceptional functionality. Mix and match - the possibilities are waiting.

Every cabinet, obviously apart from the version with an integrated flowerpot casing, can be complemented with an upper unit. Fronts can be freely selected from all available options, including open cabinets. This flexibility allows to divide your cabinet into two distinct variants. Mix and combine them to create a solution that perfectly matches your way of organising items. The only guideline is that the entire height of the set (cabinet + upper cabinet) can’t exceed 6 OH.

Classic wardrobes remain an essential part of the K42 range, with solutions thoughtfully tailored to the interior and its users.

To create a space that feels comfortable, welcoming and well-organized, the K42 line offers a versatile range of wardrobes. Equipped with hangers, shelves and an optional internal mirror, each wardrobe delivers the essential functionality expected from this type of furniture. Hinged or sliding doors adapt seamlessly to the available space, while a wide choice of dimensions reflects a strong focus on customization. All that points make K42 wardrobes truly tailored solutions.

Every detail of K42 is focused on both functionality and design.

Variety of handles – two types available in multiple colours Plastic grip profile as an option for cabinets with sliding doors Upholstered or felt panels for cabinets’ backrests for improved space acoustics Three base types: plastic glides, metal plinth and four high legs

The K42 line isn’t only about cabinets that stay fixed – it also includes a mobile sideboard that eagerly relocates where needed most.

Combination of shelves hidden by hinged doors and practical drawers offers more than just storage function – it’s a versatile companion in your office workspace. Elegant and functional, it provides extra storage space wherever you need it. Ready to stand by the wall, beside desks or freely as a smart space divider, it adapts to your space and your workflow. Available in three widths and featuring the same range of handles as other K42 elements, it’s a truly versatile solution that fits smartly every office layout.

All K42 cabinets share a consistent set of features, but one model calls for a closer look - the combi cabinet. It solves the challenge of introducing plants to office. As the name suggests, the combi cabinet brings together storage and a dedicated flowerpot cover, all merged into a single, unified form.

Combi cabinet with integrated flowerpot case

products.sourceDescription:
Kanu is a series of distinctive, moulded plywood lounge armchairs. Designed for use in lounges, offices, public and domestic interiors.

Consistency of design At a certain point in the design process, the idea that the entire armchair, including the base, should be made of plywood, cropped up. The Kanu base was therefore cut from flat plywood and given a specific edge radius. The use of the same material was the result of a certain logic and consistency in this product. The result of the work on the base is the wide, sloping legs. To give the chair depth and elegance, it was decided to paint the base black. Thanks to this treatment, we see a beautiful interplay of light when we look at Kanu. The light reflected on the surface of the legs is almost architectural, it enhances the shape and makes the whole armchair more dynamic.

“Designing the Kanu armchair was thoroughly inspiring. In theory it is said that it is best to design without constraints, which is not true, because you do not know what the reference points are. In the case of the Kanu, that point was rectangular plywood, bent in one plane with a radius of 500 mm. That is where everything started. Everything else is the result of subsequent decisions to create the product in the most logical way possible. Hence the idea of designing a range of seats with such an amazing shape.” Tomasz Augustyniak designer

Kanu lounge armchairs are all about variety In keeping with current trends, there is also a version of the Kanu armchair on a metal base. Visually light with an industrial character. This interesting design alternative makes the armchair a striking design element in a variety of interiors. As well as different frames, it has two different backrests – a fully elliptical one and one with a beautifully undercut arch. Kanu can also feature an upholstered pad, not only on the seat, but also on the backrest. It is an appealing armchair in different guises. Kanu offers an impressive range of options in various styles. Kanu lounge armchairs are all about variety

The Lupino Soft Seating collection includes the Lupino Lounge and Lupino armchairs - designed for comfortable, professional work and care environments.

Professionalism in a comfortable form Lupino is a versatile solution for healthcare settings, modern offices and public spaces such as airports. It introduces comfort, safety and elegance wherever functionality and refined aesthetics matter most. It performs equally well in consulting rooms, waiting areas, offices and meeting rooms, offering everyday support to users.

The organic form of the shell, inspired by the lupine flower, brings softness and subtle dynamism to the collection. Elegance and style A slender silhouette and carefully balanced proportions create a cohesive, professional image. Its welcoming form and easy-to-clean materials support the creation of safe, aesthetically pleasing interiors for patients, visitors and staff. Comfort and safety in care

Support at its best Lupino Lounge provides stable support thanks to its enveloping winged backrest and generously sized seat with a load capacity of up to 130 kg. The raised seat height and carefully designed seat angles make sitting down and standing up easier, promoting a natural, upright posture.

products.sourceDescription:
Metal office pedestal – functionality that works with you Meti is a metal office pedestal designed for modern workspaces. It combines durability, functionality and a simple form that naturally fits into a variety of environments – from traditional offices and flexible workspaces to home offices. It is a practical solution that meets everyday organizational needs – solid, compact and designed with user comfort in mind. Thoughtful organisation with three functional drawers Soft-close drawers as standard for enhanced working comfort Full mobility with four casters Central lock securing all drawers simultaneously Durable metal construction ensuring stability and strength Fully assembled and ready to use upon delivery

Thoughtful organization Three functional drawers help keep your workspace organized and provide quick access to the things you need most: Top drawer – with a removable pencil tray for small accessories Middle drawer – versatile storage space Bottom drawer – with a metal rail for hanging files Different load capacities (10 kg for the two upper drawers and 20 kg for the bottom drawer) ensure reliable performance even with intensive everyday use.

Consistent aesthetics Available in two timeless colors – white and black – the pedestal complements a wide range of office interiors. The black interior of the drawers further emphasizes its minimalist character.

Rounded edges increase user safety and give the product a modern, refined appearance. Metal construction ensures resistance to intensive use, stability and long-lasting durability. Soft-close mechanism comes as standard, ensuring smooth and silent drawer closing while enhancing user comfort and the acoustics of the space.

Minimalist design, maximum functionality A simple, refined aesthetic allows Meti to blend seamlessly with different furniture ranges and complement workstations perfectly – both in office and home environments. It is an ideal solution wherever organization, mobility and everyday comfort matter.

products.sourceDescription:
Sideboards Triple Box's essential role is to support brainstorming rounds and workshops. A model equipped with a whiteboard is to write down all the ideas, while a TV holder provides a multimedia spot to present the necessary materials. With the pouffes and small tables designed specifically to fit the size of the open shelves, and the drawers for keeping markers or post-its at hand, Triple Box complies with all the needs of a creative zone. All set! Single Box with cushion is a typical 2in1 solution - it serves as a storage unit and an instant place to seat.

Cabinets The Coffee Point cabinet and the Waste Box pedestal make for comfortable assistance when a cup of tea during a longer meeting is so very welcome. These two models remind one of the importance of balance between hard working and relaxing. Only a combination of those two makes sense. The MBox cabinet seen frontally may seem to be just a piece of storage furniture but after turning around, two whiteboards and a pinboard appear. The open shelves are designed to fit two pouffes so with this only one cabinet a spontaneous small meeting can be successfully carried out! Open metal cabinets, besides the obvious role of being storage units, can also divide a bigger space discreetly. Building zones with those cabinets is quick and the outcome looks smart.

products.sourceDescription:
Otuli combines minimalist, functional design with unique comfort. The armchair’s wide seat provides comfort during long hours of sitting and the comfortable armrests and backrest, reclining synchronously with the seat, ensure complete relaxation. Its four-star swivel base and leg rest provide freedom of movement, making the armchair an excellent choice for an office or chillout zone. Its modern look fits perfectly into a variety of arrangements, bringing elegance and functionality to the interior. Minimalist and functional design Cosy headrest Wide seat Comfortable armrests Backrest reclines synchronously with the seat Four-star swivel base Leg rest

Synchronised for comfort - a backrest that adapts to you The backrest reclines synchronously with the seat, ensuring a perfect fit to the natural movements of the body to increase comfort of use.With the sync function, the armchair responds to any change in position, providing balanced support and minimising tensions in the body. Backrest synchronisation with the seat allows the user to smoothly transition to a more relaxed position without compromising comfort. The feature makes the chair extremely comfortable, both while working and resting.

Otuli – comfort and style in any space The Otuli armchair with a swivel leg rest is a perfect choice for various spaces that combine functionality with relaxation. It is ideal for offices, where it will provide comfortable conditions for informal work while also offering a moment of rest thanks to the backrest and seat synchronisation. The armchair can also be successfully used in chillout zones, offices and hotel lobbies, creating a space that encourages recovery. Its elegant design also makes it a perfect match for modern living spaces, combining aesthetics with comfort.

Elegant leg rest that works perfectly with the Otuli armchair A leg rest that ideally combines functionality with elegance, it was designed as a harmonious complement to the Otuli armchair but it also makes a perfect stand-alone seat. Thanks to its universal design and stylish finish, it can serve as a comfortable support for your feet while relaxing or a practical seat in any interior. However you use it, the leg rest adds a unique character to the space, emphasizing style and coherence of the arrangement.

products.sourceDescription:
Prox. All around comfort Comfort-driven design Soft and light 3D mesh fabric on the backrest Adjustable lumbar support Seat made of endure and comfortable injected foam Two colour concepts: light grey and black Advanced 4D armrests

Expand your comfort zone We made an office chair that thinks ahead. A concept-based design expands your comfort zone with every move you make. More than just a seat, it’s an intuitive work companion that adapts in real time, effortlessly following the way you sit and supporting you exactly the way you need it.

Feel how easy is to lean back, shift or stretch. This chair moves with you, sensing your rhythm and adjusting seamlessly. The comfort is dynamic and keeps up with your pace to deliver ergonomic seating. Feel how Prox supports you while working. When comfort moves with you, your productivity follows.

Comfort unlocked With a mechanism that keeps up with your motion, Prox chair provides perfect support when you are deeply focused, gathering your thoughts or just having a talk with co-workers. This chair helps to keep the balance.

Prox is going beyond expectations and changes the perception of comfort An office chair’s principle task is to support and dynamically adjust to the user's needs without engaging one's attention. It’s not just about comfort, it’s about intelligent design that seamlessly ensures healthier work style.

A good meeting needs great seats. The Prox chair provides the comfort to stay focused, helping meetings become more productive. It’s yet another role that an ergonomic chair plays in today’s modern, purpose-driven offices.

Prox was a true design challenge where ergonomics and aesthetics merge into a seamless, fluid form. Its wide backrest extends gracefully to support the shoulders, while the lumbar reinforcement and three-dimensional contours follow an organic flow of interconnected ellipses. A masterpiece of both comfort and design. Prox is more than a chair - it’s an ergonomic sculpture. Martin Ballendat Designer

The power of eco-design The products we bring into our offer are aligned with eco-design principles. The functionality blends with the eco-conscious thinking, so the products and solutions keep sustainable and planet-friendly. The Prox line reflects that mindset by: The recycled content is, depending on the Prox model, over 28% (for black) and over 16% (for grey). Over 99% of the product is suitable for further recycling Natural fabrics - Main Line Flax, Blazer, Synergy and Remix 3 - with high natural fibre content Injected foam - perfect fit for maximum efficiency

Smart design Let Prox provide the most convenient setup for you.

Adjustable headrest, possible to fold flat Adjustable, elliptic-shaped lumbar support Comfortable yet durable seat thanks to the injected foam Wide upper part of the backrest and “narrow waist” for additional shoulder support

The Prox model with the headrest will be available in the early Q1 2026.

Designer spotlight Martin Ballendat Martin Ballendat has been a successful designer for 25 years now. Since 1995 he has been running his own design studio in Upper Austria. He has also opened his second studio in Germany. He has been working for famous brands from over 10 countries. His projects have been internationally acclaimed – in his career, he has been given more than 100 awards, including 17 Red Dot awards.

products.sourceDescription:
Take care of the acoustic in your office with Sileo

1 / 2 Sileo Levels Sileo Levels line have been designed as a result of a research project carried out by our team of acoustic engineers. The main purpose of these panels is to facilitate optimal acoustic conditions in rooms with different finishes. Typical upholstered acoustic panels can effectively absorb a limited range of frequencies, and they can actually make an existing problem even worse in some cases. Compared to existing solutions, perforated panels can be used to better match the sound absorption range to the specific problem occurring in a particular space. Sileo Levels With three different thicknesses, the panels can be used to create interesting spatial forms which expand the arrangement potential, while ensuring the right absorption characteristics for offices. As a result, the Treble panel is the most effective for high frequency tones, the Middle panel for medium frequency, and the Bass panel for low frequency tones. A combination of the three panels in the right proportions offers sound absorption for a wide range of frequencies, which is recommended for spaces fitted with hardly any other absorbing materials, such as carpets or acoustic ceilings.

Sileo Pro Panels dedicated to managerial and boardroom meeting rooms not only increase their acoustic comfort but also embellish and raise their rank. They are inspired by modert art and their wide range of finishes guarantees a fit to any space.

products.sourceDescription:
Sitari. A chair that always finds its place. A modern chair designed for spaces where comfort, functionality, and durability matter. Every interior needs furniture that not only looks good but also works seamlessly with the space. Sitari was created to meet the needs of dynamic offices, conference rooms, and meeting places in the hospitality and gastronomy sector. Its simple design, ergonomic shapes, and stackability make Sitari ready for the challenges of everyday life - without compromise. Design Nowy Styl Design Team Plastic (Black, White, Taupe, Coral, Green, Light blue, Grey) or upholstered shell Armrests integrated with the frame Black armrest pads Base: four legs or cantilever frame Stackable up to 4 chairs - models with plastic seat shell

Why Sitari? Minimalist form – maximum functionality. • Universal design – adapts to any interior. • Comfort – plastic shell with optional upholstery and armrests. • Durability – stable steel frame, powder-coated or chrome finish. • Mobility – lightweight and easy to move or arrange in different layouts. • Practicality – stackable up to 4 chairs for convenient storage.

More colour. Sitari. The minimalist form of the Sitari chair now offers even more arrangement possibilities. Four new colours have been added to the range of plastic shells: Coral, Green, Light Blue and Grey. Thanks to them, it is now even easier to match the chair to the character of a space - from calm, subdued interiors to more expressive and creative arrangements.

One chair – many possibilities. Sitari doesn’t dominate with its style, but it always adds character to a space. With clean lines and functional form, it fits into various interiors – from modern open-space offices, through elegant conference rooms, to lively restaurants and cafés. • Office – lightness and ergonomics support the team’s daily work. • Conference – stackability allows quick room preparation for meetings. • Hospitality – durability and easy maintenance make Sitari ideal even in high-traffic spaces.

Versions: plastic or upholstered shell, available in various colours and fabrics Frame: steel, available with four legs or sled base Finish: powder-coated or chrome Armrests: integrated with the frame, with TPE pads Comfort: a modern form that provides natural ease of use Stackability: up to 4 chairs for easier storage

The Tento 2.0 mobile pedestals seamlessly blend practical solutions with contemporary design. Meticulously engineered for optimal workstation organisation, they provide a dedicated and secure space for documents and office essentials. Thanks to their mobility and high-quality finish, they are a versatile addition to any modern office environment.

Metal drawers (Metabox) and a pencil tray Two widths available: standard (432 mm) and slim (332 mm)

Standard or slim? A perfect fit The Tento 2.0 mobile pedestals are available in two sizes, both featuring a practical three-drawer configuration on Metabox metal runners. • The standard version (432 mm wide) is a classic solution, offering ample storage capacity and stability under the desk. • The Slim version (just 332 mm wide) allows for significant space-saving in smaller areas without compromising on functionality. Both models are equipped with a central lock and braked castors, providing effortless mobility and secure storage.

Excellence in the details The functionality of Tento 2.0 pedestals can be further enhanced with optional upholstered pads, which also serve as a convenient seat and introduce a subtle colour accent to the interior. The line offers modern handles in metal or plastic, all featuring a minimalist design. Additional customisation is possible with a soft-close mechanism for the drawers and a practical pencil tray for improved internal organisation.

products.sourceDescription:
Trofi – ergonomics for everyday work The Trofi chair has been designed for modern, dynamic work environments where comfort, functionality, and reliability matter most. It combines proven ergonomic solutions with a simple, neutral form, responding to the needs of both individual users and collaborative teams. Height-adjustable headrest Mesh backrest with adjustable lumbar support 2D armrests Synchronous mechanism Adjustable backrest tilt force with a knob Smooth seat height adjustment and anti-shock function

Comfort and ergonomics without compromise The Trofi chair is designed to support correct posture and ensure comfort throughout the working day. The breathable mesh backrest, ergonomically contoured seat and intuitive adjustments allow the chair to be quickly and easily adjusted to the user, regardless of the time and nature of the tasks performed.

One chair — many spaces Thanks to its universal design and restrained aesthetics, Trofi fits seamlessly into a wide range of interiors — from large open-space offices to smaller learning and individual work areas. Its neutral color palette supports visual consistency and allows for easy integration with other furnishings. Trofi is a thoughtful combination of ergonomics and functionality — a solution created for modern workplaces.

The height-adjustable headrest allows for easy customization to the user’s height, providing proper support for the head and cervical spine. The breathable mesh backrest combined with adjustable lumbar support ensures comfort and stable back support throughout the workday. Height-adjustable armrests with forward and backward sliding pads enable ergonomic arm positioning and effectively reduce shoulder strain during desk work. The ergonomically contoured seat allows for quick adjustment to the user and supports seating comfort during prolonged periods of work.

products.sourceDescription:
Enhanced seating comfort The slightly curved, ergonomically pronounced seat shell seems to wrap itself around the body of its occupant, while the fabric-like structure of the surface adds a haptically soft touch to the seating experience. Enhanced seating comfort

V-Care benches ideal for travel environments Worldwide, more than 260 international airports have furnished their environments with our waiting benches, seat islands or lounge furniture. These products are specifically designed for the waiting areas in airports, tried-and-tested in terminals as well as bus and railway stations. V-Care benches ideal for travel environments

PRM version An expression of inclusive design is thinking about people with reduced mobility in any space, including public spaces, such as airport terminals, railway stations or hospitals. The result is the design of the V-Care bench in the PRM version. These models provide the option of ordering raised seat shell in different configurations, depending on the number of seats in the bench. PRM version

“With sensitive intelligence to innovate simplicity.” Justus Kolberg designer

1 / 2 Designed for healthcare. Ready for public spaces. V-Care Fold is a compact, hygienic, and ergonomic solution designed primarily for hospitals and clinics, while also being ideal for schools, government offices, and other high-traffic public spaces. The folding seats enhance safety, help maintain order, and ensure smooth user flow in waiting areas, corridors, and communication routes. The entire system has been designed to support everyday operations and meet the requirements of environments with the highest safety standards. Safety and hygiene confirmed by standards V-Care Fold uses medical-grade materials that are easy to disinfect and meet fire-retardancy requirements (EN 1021-1, EN 1021-2, DIN 66084 P-a). Its durable steel construction ensures long-lasting performance and resistance to intensive use. When folded, the seats do not reduce the width of evacuation routes, supporting user safety and the efficient operation of emergency services.

1 / 2 User comfort in a compact form The soft-close folding mechanism prevents the seat from closing abruptly when the user stands up, increasing safety while ensuring quiet, smooth operation. An optional open-position lock guarantees stability, which is especially important for elderly users, weakened patients, or those with limited mobility. As a result, V-Care Fold is a user-friendly solution for both patients and medical staff, supporting safe sitting and standing while helping maintain order in shared spaces. Flexible configurations and cohesive design V-Care Fold is available as a single seat or as benches for 2–6 users, with three mounting options: freestanding, wall-mounted, and floor-mounted. Two seat-height options allow the model to be tailored to diverse user needs. Its design aligns seamlessly with the V-Care product line, ensuring durability, functionality, and a visually cohesive appearance—even when the seats are folded.

V-Care bench V-Care bench

products.sourceDescription:
Bringing art into public spaces Art has become a vibrant source of inspiration for the Nowy Styl Design Team and Maria Drągowska. They worked together to create Versi. The heritage of the Memphis Group, founded by Ettore Sottsass in Milan, was their key inspiration as they designed this multifunctional product. Sottsass was one of the leading Italian designers and the group was famous for their avant-garde forms, colours and designs that defined the aesthetics of the 1980s. With its modern form and attractive colour palette, Versi responds to the needs of office spaces. It brings a pinch of artistic sensitivity to the work environment and can be a perfect complement to the design of any room. To put it short: it just rivets the eye.

Ready to use Versi is an intuitive product ready for instant use. It is characterized by a complementary structure which also saves space. The individual components can be easily deconstructed, so Versi can be quickly transformed into three seats and a functional coffee table. The lightness and mobility of the product bring out its high comfort of use.

Play with form With its intuitive form, Versi inspires users to explore and play creatively with different layouts. No matter how you arrange the pouffs, they always look impressive. Indulge yourself in experimenting with form and various configurations.

Play with colours Playing with colours is vital to any space, and Versi makes perfect use of it. It allows you to create diverse colour sets to emphasize the unique character of any space or room. Not only does Versi fit perfectly into the aesthetics of any space, but it will also perfectly complement it, making it look absolutely unique.

WithME - a chair with high IQ Comfortable solution for meeting rooms Perfect choice for home office Three backrest types: perforated plastic, upholstered and mesh Smart mechanism, self-adapting to the user’s weight Agile, light (approx. 9 kg) and mobile Two colour concepts: black and light grey

WithME boosts team-oriented behaviors so it's a first-choice having agile and collaborative work in mind. It's an instant solution for all the places where people meet and spend limited time, yet require a proper ergonomic chair.

The new work culture strongly promotes team working, mobility and readiness to switch between topics, people and places. WithME understands such attitude and lets every user experience advanced ergonomics and comfort effortlessly, with barely no adjustment. WithME is a perfect match for all the spaces where interactions matter.

Modern offices are definitely the places for inspirational meetings and co-working. WithME supports such habits, being a team spirit booster.

Three backrests to make WithME 100% yours Different options share a common design, ensuring visual coherence even when mixed together.

The perforated, net-like plastic backrest ensures pleasant airflow. It’s flexible, ergonomically shaped and also easy to keep clean. Soft fabric with a layer of foam provides comfortable support for your back. A wide selection of upholsteries suits every design concept. The mesh version sits perfectly between the two mentioned options - airy and light yet cosy and pleasant to the touch. This model features a 3D mesh that is slightly thicker than standard mesh, offering enhanced comfort.

If it happens that your home acts as your job spot, WithME is basically the best choice due to its discreet look. WithME never dominates, but gets almost invisible when slipped under the table top.

The ability of self-adjusting to the user's weight and size, makes WithME a perfect chair for home working where entire family can comfortably use the same seating to work, learn or play.

Designer spotlight Martin Ballendat Martin Ballendat has been a successful designer for 25 years now. Since 1995 he has been running his own design studio in Upper Austria. He has also opened his second studio in Germany. He has been working for famous brands from over 10 countries. His projects have been internationally acclaimed – in his career, he has been given more than 100 awards, including 17 Red Dot awards.

Transparency is a value in itself. Watch the WithME making-of as we have nothing to hide.

Sit as you like!

The backrest wide tilt angle allows for free and dynamic sitting, which is the biggest advantage for the user’s back muscles, spine and the entire metabolic system. The DYNAMIC PLUS mechanism is characterised by a large backrest tilt range, which guarantees high sitting comfort during everyday work.

Diversity is interesting, as is the fact that each of us is different. It is a great challenge to provide comfortable conditions for people with different body shapes and sizes. Xenium offers an incredible scope of adjustment options and a possibility to choose additional functions to ensure long-lasting and exceptional comfort of use.

Flexibility is one of the most important features an office should possess. With the possibility to choose from three types of backrest – Duo-Back, UPH and Mesh – and the ability to change them easily, we are able to ensure flexibility for every employee, to meet their needs and preferences.

Duo-Back The Duo-Back backrest consists of two symmetrical parts mounted on movable connectors. Therefore, it does not press directly on the vertebrae and disks and reduces the pressure on the spine to 50%.

Your spine doesn’t like staying still. Neither does Duo-Back! The Xenium Duo-Back backrest is designed to support your spine without restricting its natural movement. Its profile follows the natural curves of your back, providing stability and a comfortable, enveloping feel. As you change position, the backrest follows your body’s movements, helping maintain comfort and the right level of support throughout the working day.

Your best business partner

1 / 2 Flexibility is one of the most important features an office should possess. Thanks to a very wide selection of Xilium configurations and a wide range of finishes you are sure that you will maintain consistency of arrangement in any space. With a choice of three backrests: Duo-Back, UPH or Mesh , you can choose the option best suited to your needs. If you are looking for an innovative backrest which does not press directly on the vertebrae and disks and reduces the pressure on the spine to 50%, Duo-Back will be the best solution. If you are looking for comfortable but more classic solutions, UPH or Mesh will be the best choice.

X-MOVE The human body moves on three planes – frontal, sagittal and transverse. Only if a chair allows this kind of movement can it be said that it helps to look after the well-being of your spine and the musculoskeletal system. The solution is our patented X-MOVE mechanism. X-MOVE allows dynamic movement on the frontal plane or to the sides. In addition, it activates a tiny rotational movement in the lumbar area. A thing to remember is that healthiest sitting is dynamic sitting.

Duo-Back The Duo-Back backrest consists of two symmetrical parts mounted on movable connectors. Therefore, it does not press directly on the vertebrae and disks and reduces the pressure on the spine to 50%.

Your spine doesn’t like staying still. Neither does Duo-Back! The Xilium Duo-Back backrest is designed to support your spine without restricting its natural movement. Its profile follows the natural curves of your back, providing stability and a comfortable, enveloping feel. As you change position, the backrest follows your body’s movements, helping maintain comfort and the right level of support throughout the working day.

Looking for more? Explore Xilium in the gaming edition!

The players of x-kom Ago team have already found out THAT IT MAKES SENSE! x-kom AGO Polish professional Counter-Strike players tested XiliumG chairs while preparing and practicing for the prestigious ESL PRO LEAGUE in 2022. Weeks of hard work, 380 hours of training to succeed. To challenge the best teams in the world.

Freely movement Our patented backrest function X-MOVE not only enables side-to-side movement and dynamic sitting but also makes that backrest follow your body movements.n X-MOVE not only enables side-to-side movement and dynamic sitting but also makes that backrest follow your body movements.

Multifunctional armrests 4D armrests adjust multi-dimensionally, boosting the convenience of working with a computer keyboard and mobile devices. Soft armrest pads provide great comfort to your elbows. Thanks to height adjustment you can easily move the chair under the table top.

One chair for different users With an advanced mechanism and armrests, XiliumG can grow or get smaller when adjusted to different body sizes as it’s dedicated for users' weight 45-150 kg. Side movement of the armrests gives user even more space. Thanks to that, Xilium G is a gaming chair which can be used by many users of different age, weigh and posture.

Two models available: with or without a headrest A breathable mesh backrest, pleasantly soft to the touch, providing free airflow Ergonomic armrests and lumbar support; additionally adjustable armrests in model with a headrest Castors with an automatic braking mechanism, suitable for both soft and hard surfaces Comfortable seat The backrest and seat with a recline function, allowing for gentle swaying Synchronous mechanism and seat depth adjustment (model with a headrest) Backrest lock in three positions: upright, intermediate and free-swing (model with headrest) Anti-Shock function Universal black colour

The comfortable, upholstered seat with a cover provides stable and comfortable seating. Additionally, the castors with an automatic braking mechanism, suitable for a variety of surfaces, and the universal black colour ensure fitting into a number of spaces. Ergonomic armrests and lumbar support help to maintain the correct posture, relieving tension in the shoulders, upper arms and lower back during everyday office work. The breathable mesh backrest is pleasantly soft and keeps the user’s back from overheating. Moreover, the Anti-Shock feature prevents the backrest from striking user’s back when the lock is released.

Model with a headrest A comfortable, height-adjustable headrest provides support for the cervical spine, whilst the synchronous mechanism offers additional spinal protection. Thanks to the synchronous mechanism, the backrest can be set to different positions, to suit the user’s needs. Backrest lock is available in upright position, perfect for work requiring concentration, free-swing position (relaxation function) and intermediate one.

The seat depth adjustment allows you to precise fitting of the chair to the user's body shape and helps maintain correct posture. In addition, the soft armrests, which are height-adjustable, with front-to-back sliding pads, ensure a natural position for the arms and wrists.

legacy.description: Kas yra ergonomika - Darbo vietos reikalavimai - Ergonomikos principai ir baldų ergonomika - Kompiuterizuotos darbo vietos ergonomika
legacy.html:
Kas yra ergonomika?

Ergonomika (gr. ergon – darbas, nomos – dėsnis) – tai mokslas, nagrinėjantis darbo vietos (įrangos, prietaisų, aplinkos, sąlygų) pritaikymą autonominėms psichofizinėms asmens savybėms ir galimybėms, jo poreikiams ir lūkesčiams, užtikrinant efektyvų ir saugų darbą. Mokslininkų sukaupta informacija vėliau pritaikoma gerinant žmonių sąveiką su produktais, sistemomis ir bendra darbo aplinka.

Svarbiausia yra darbą ir darbo aplinką pritaikyti žmonėms, o ne atvirkščiai. Dažnai, norėdamas dirbti efektyviau ir saugiau, žmogus yra priverstas prisitaikyti prie esamų sąlygų darbo vietoje. Taip būti neturėtų, todėl pritaikius ergonomikos mokslo žinias ir principus, yra įmanoma sukurti geriausią, ergonomišką darbo vietą.

Darbo vietos ergonomika

Darbo vietos ergonomika yra daugybės mūsų įpročių derinys, taip pat tinkamos įrangos, tokios kaip patogi kėdė, didelis monitorius ir reguliuojamo aukščio stalas pasirinkimas. Darbo vietoje taikant ergonomiškus, mūsų kūną tausojančius įrangos sprendimus, net ilgos darbo valandos nebebus susijusios su diskomfortu.

Darbo vietos reikalavimai

Lietuvoje galioja ir kompiuterinės darbo vietos įrengimą bei darbo su kompiuteriu saugos reikalavimus reglamentuoja higienos norma HN 32:2004 „Darbas su video terminalais. Saugos ir sveikatos reikalavimai“. Ir nors reikalavimai taikomi tik darbo vietai, rūpindamiesi savo sveikata turėtume laikytis nurodymų ir tiesiog leisdami laisvalaikį ar mokydamiesi prie rašomojo stalo, kompiuterio. Svarbu:

– darbo vietai skirti baldai, atitinkantys ergonominius reikalavimus;

– poilsio ir darbo režimas (turi būti daromos pertraukos, keičiama veikla, specialūs pratimai akims atpalaiduoti);

– periodiškas sveikatos tikrinimas (ypač akių ir regėjimo);

– nepavojinga sveikatai kompiuterinė įranga (stabilus vaizdas, reguliuojamas ryškumas ir kontrastas ekrane, lengvai pasukamas ar pakreipiamas monitorius);

– šviesos šaltiniai patalpoje (neturi akinti, kad nekeltų nemalonių pojūčių ir akių nuovargio);

– higienos normas atitinkantis natūralus ir dirbtinis apšvietimas;

– pakankamas erdvės plotas;

– triukšmas ir vibracija (neturi viršyti nustatytų normų);

– šiluminė aplinka;

– spinduliuotė;

– oro kokybė.

Kompiuterizuotos darbo vietos ergonomika

Kompiuterizuotos darbo vietos ergonomika turi įtakos daugeliui aspektų. Ergonomiška darbo vieta pirmiausiai turi būti saugi. Įrengta taip, kad niekas negalėtų lengvai apvirsti, nukristi ar kaip nors kitaip kažką sugadinti ar sužeisti. Saugi darbo vieta reiškia ne tik kuo mažesnę nelaimingų atsitikimų riziką, bet ir galimybę dirbti patogioje pozicijoje. Taip išvengsite laikysenos ir kraujotakos problemų, įvairių kitų negalavimų, kurie gali kilti, jei darbo vieta yra prastai įrengta ir išdėstyta. 

Kompiuterizuotos darbo vietos ergonomika siejama ir su didesniu efektyvumu. Turėdami patogią darbo vietą, kur kas rečiau sukinėsitės ieškodami patogesnės kūno padėties. Diskomforto nebuvimas taip pat leis geriau susikoncentruoti į atliekamas užduotis. Tai savo ruožtu sumažins kasdienį stresą ir nuovargio jausmą, jums bus lengviau viską suspėti laiku.

Patogi darbo vieta taip pat užtikrina geresnį bendravimą su kolegomis ar klientais. Atminkite, kad santykiams su kitais žmonėmis įtakos turi daug veiksnių. Taigi, jei apribosite neigiamus dirgiklius (tai tikrai yra ir nugaros skausmas ar nepatogi padėtis), galite pagerinti savo komunikaciją ir sustiprinti kontaktus.

Ergonomikos principai ir baldų ergonomika

Nors ergonomikos reikalavimai darbo vietai aprašyti teisės aktuose ir rinkoje yra daugybė ergonomiškų gaminių, daugelis darbo vietų vis dar neatitinka geros ergonomikos principų. Verta atkreipti dėmesį į kelis pagrindinius ergonomiškos darbo vietos ir baldų ergonomikos rodiklius:

– STALAS. Stalo aukštis turėtų būti reguliuojamas, stalviršis turi būti ties alkūnėmis arba šiek tiek žemiau jų. Idealus variantas – ergonominis pakeliamas mechaninis arba elektrinis (reguliuojamo aukščio) stalas, prie kurio galima saugiai ir patogiai dirbti tiek sėdint, tiek stovint. Toks stalas lengvai pritaikomas vaikams ir suaugusiems pagal jų ūgį.

– KĖDĖ turi palaikyti jūsų stuburo linkius, gerinti laikyseną. Visų gerų ergonomiškų kėdžių paslaptis yra galimybė judėti pirmyn ir atgal, į šonus, aukštyn ir žemyn, išlaikant teisingą nugaros padėtį. Kuo daugiau judesių, tuo geriau. Mes tai vadiname aktyviu sėdėjimu. Jis stiprina pagrindinius raumenis ir sąnarius, tinkamai subalansuoja stuburo padėtį, gerina kūno laikyseną, padeda labiau susikaupti darbo metu ir didina koncentracijos lygį. Vienos paklausiausių tokių kėdžių yra klūpėjimo kėdė ir judanti stovėjimo kėdė.

– KOMPIUTERIS. Kompiuterio monitorius turi būti priešais jus, už klaviatūros, ištiestos rankos atstumu, akių lygyje arba šiek tiek žemiau. Jei monitorius yra per žemai, pagelbės ergonomiškas, reguliuojamo aukščio monitoriaus laikiklis.

– KLAVIATŪRA IR PELĖ turi būti lengvai pasiekiamoje vietoje ant to paties lygaus paviršiaus. Naudojant klaviatūrą arbą pelę, riešai turi būti tiesūs, alkūnių lygyje arba šiek tiek žemiau, pečiai turi būti atpalaiduoti. Šiuolaikinė ergonominė kompiuterinė pelė atitaikyta pagal natūralų riešo linkį, o klaviatūros ženklai išdėstyti taip, kad būtų patogu naudotis, todėl ranka mažiau pavargsta, tausojami riešo sąnariai, o sureguliavus pelės jautrumą darbo krūvis rankai dar labiau sumažinamas.

– TELEFONAS. Jeigu dirbant prie kompiuterio, spausdinant klaviatūra, tuo pat metu dažnai tenka bendrauti telefonu, rekomenduojama naudoti garsiakalbį arba ausines. Telefono prilaikymas spaudžiant petimi prie galvos ne tik vargina, bet ir kenkia kaklui bei stuburui.

– KITI DAIKTAI (telefonas, dokumentai, užrašai, rašikliai ir t.t.), reikalingi darbo metu, turi būti lengvai pasiekiami.

Patogi darbo vieta taip pat užtikrina geresnį bendravimą su kolegomis ar klientais. Atminkite, kad santykiams su kitais žmonėmis įtakos turi daug veiksnių. Taigi, jei apribosite neigiamus dirgiklius (tai tikrai yra ir nugaros skausmas ar nepatogi padėtis), galite pagerinti savo komunikaciją ir sustiprinti kontaktus.

Nors ergonomikos reikalavimai darbo vietai aprašyti teisės aktuose ir rinkoje yra daugybė ergonomiškų gaminių, daugelis darbo vietų vis dar neatitinka geros ergonomikos principų. Verta atkreipti dėmesį į kelis pagrindinius ergonomiškos darbo vietos ir baldų ergonomikos rodiklius: – STALAS. Stalo aukštis turėtų būti reguliuojamas, stalviršis turi būti ties alkūnėmis arba šiek tiek žemiau jų. Idealus variantas – ergonominis pakeliamas mechaninis arba elektrinis (reguliuojamo aukščio) stalas, prie kurio galima saugiai ir patogiai dirbti tiek sėdint, tiek stovint. Toks stalas lengvai pritaikomas vaikams ir suaugusiems pagal jų ūgį. – KĖDĖ turi palaikyti jūsų stuburo linkius, gerinti laikyseną. Visų gerų ergonomiškų kėdžių paslaptis yra galimybė judėti pirmyn ir atgal, į šonus, aukštyn ir žemyn, išlaikant teisingą nugaros padėtį. Kuo daugiau judesių, tuo geriau. Mes tai vadiname aktyviu sėdėjimu. Jis stiprina pagrindinius raumenis ir sąnarius, tinkamai subalansuoja stuburo padėtį, gerina kūno laikyseną, padeda labiau susikaupti darbo metu ir didina koncentracijos lygį. Vienos paklausiausių tokių kėdžių yra klūpėjimo kėdė ir judanti stovėjimo kėdė. – KOMPIUTERIS. Kompiuterio monitorius turi būti priešais jus, už klaviatūros, ištiestos rankos atstumu, akių lygyje arba šiek tiek žemiau. Jei monitorius yra per žemai, pagelbės ergonomiškas, reguliuojamo aukščio monitoriaus laikiklis. – KLAVIATŪRA IR PELĖ turi būti lengvai pasiekiamoje vietoje ant to paties lygaus paviršiaus. Naudojant klaviatūrą arbą pelę, riešai turi būti tiesūs, alkūnių lygyje arba šiek tiek žemiau, pečiai turi būti atpalaiduoti. Šiuolaikinė ergonominė kompiuterinė pelė atitaikyta pagal natūralų riešo linkį, o klaviatūros ženklai išdėstyti taip, kad būtų patogu naudotis, todėl ranka mažiau pavargsta, tausojami riešo sąnariai, o sureguliavus pelės jautrumą darbo krūvis rankai dar labiau sumažinamas. – TELEFONAS. Jeigu dirbant prie kompiuterio, spausdinant klaviatūra, tuo pat metu dažnai tenka bendrauti telefonu, rekomenduojama naudoti garsiakalbį arba ausines. Telefono prilaikymas spaudžiant petimi prie galvos ne tik vargina, bet ir kenkia kaklui bei stuburui. – KITI DAIKTAI (telefonas, dokumentai, užrašai, rašikliai ir t.t.), reikalingi darbo metu, turi būti lengvai pasiekiami.

legacy.title: Biuro kėdės - ergonominės kėdės - balansinės kėdės
legacy.description: Modernios biuro kėdės- Ergonominės kėdės- Ofiso baldų projektavimas, gamyba, prekyba- Patarimai kaip išsirinkti biuro kėdes
legacy.html:
Kaip išsirinkti biuro kėdes?

Biuro kėdės sėdimą darbą dirbančių žmonių gyvenime užima beveik trečdalį gyvenimo laiko. Daugelis net nesusimąstome, kad kasdien dirbdami po 8 valandas, 5 dienas per savaitę, per metus sėdime daugiau kaip 2000 valandų. Tinkamos darbo kėdės pasirinkimas daro labai didelę įtaką mūsų sveikatai, laikysenai ir bendrai gerovei.  Nuo ko pradėti, jei nusprendėte įsirengti darbo vietą namuose ar biure, gavote nurodymą nupirkti biuro kėdę viršininkui arba keletą kėdžių biurui? Kviečiame peržiūrėti mūsų komandos parengtą straipsnį, kuriame aprašėme, į ką pirmiausia reikėtų atkreipti dėmesį renkantis ofiso kėdes.

Biuro kėdės atlošo ir sėdynės forma

Visų pirma, biuro kėdė turi būti patogi, o jos patogumą sukuria atlošas ir sėdynė. Atkreipkite dėmesį į atlošo formą. Ergonomišku laikomas atlošas, kuris kuo arčiau priglunda prie vartotojo nugaros ir turi maksimalų sąlyčio taškų skaičių. Labai svarbus elementas yra išlinkimas juosmens srityje. Ir jei šis išlenkimas yra tiksliai juosmens dalies lygyje – ši kėdė nesukels nugaros nuovargio. Atkreipkite dėmesį, ar atlošo šonuose yra ergonominiai išlenkimai. Šių elementų užduotis yra išlaikyti taisyklingą stuburo laikyseną. Kuo daugiau nugara bus prigludusi prie kėdės atlošo, tuo geriau jausitės darbo dienos pabaigoje.

Kitas dalykas, į kurį atkreiptume dėmesį, yra biuro kėdės sėdynė. Optimalus sėdynės gylis laikomas tada, kai atsisėdus tarp kelio sulenkimo ir sėdynės galo lieka delno pločio atstumas. Tai svarbu, nes perteklinis spaudimas po sulenktu keliu sukels kraujagyslių spaudimą, kojų tinimą ir bendrą nuovargį. Ergonomiškos kėdės – atskira diskusijų tema. Tokios kėdės sukurtos siekiant maksimalaus komforto, o taip pat palengvintų žmonių, turinčių netaisyklingą laikyseną ar patiriančių nugaros skausmus, gyvenimą. Žinoma, ergonomiškos kėdės yra universalus sprendimas ir tinka daugeliui vartotojų.

Galvos atramos ir porankių pasirinkimas

Ar svarbu atkreipti dėmesį į tai, kad biuro kėdėje yra porankiai ir galvos atrama? Viskas priklauso nuo jūsų asmeninių pageidavimų ir laiko, praleidžiamo kėdėje. Porankių ir galvos atramos labiausiai reikalingos tiems, kurie daug dirba arba dėl darbo specifikos negali pasitraukti nuo kėdės. Patogu kartais atremti galvą į galvos atramą, padėti rankas į patogią padėtį ir leisti sau kelias minutes pailsėti.

Ofiso kėdžių mechanizmai: kokie reguliavimo mechanizmai reikalingiausi?

Kaip suprantate, neįmanoma sukurti universalios kėdės, kuri tiktų visiems naudotojams. Todėl galimybė kėdę pritaikyti pagal vartotojo poreikius yra labai svarbi. Atsižvelgiant į tai, kad visi žmonės yra skirtingo ūgio, gamintojai numato galimybę reguliuoti biuro kėdės aukštį praktiškai visiems modeliams. Labai patogu, kai yra reguliuojamas ir atlošo bei sėdynės pasvyrimo kampas. Šiems tikslams yra visas mechanizmų arsenalas. Visi jie gali turėti savo funkcijas su skirtingu reguliavimu, ir, atsižvelgiant į galimybes, montuojami ant skirtingų modelių ofiso kėdžių. Paprastai kuo kėdė brangesnė, tuo daugiau funkcionalumo ji turi. Minimalus reguliavimo rinkinys turėtų apimti sėdynės aukščio ir atlošo bei sėdynės pasvyrimo kampo reguliavimą. Dar geriau turėti kėdę su galimybe reguliuoti atlošo aukštį, o jei dizainas numato – tai ir porankių bei galvos atramos aukštį. Nemažai modelių taip pat aprūpinti laisvojo sūpavimosi funkcija, kuri įgalina aktyvų sėdėjimą – tai labai patogus pasirinkimas žmonėms, kurių gyvenimas glaudžiai susijęs su darbu prie stalo.

Biuro kėdės bazė

Plastikinėms penkiažvaigždėms bazėms svorio riba yra ~120 kg. Tai nereiškia, kad nuo didesnio vartotojo svorio kėdė sulūš. Kėdė su tokia baze taip pat tarnaus, tačiau galimai po kiek laiko ją teks keisti. Dėl mažos kainos kėdės su plastikine baze visada bus populiariausios. Jei įprasta kėdės apkrova viršija 120 kg, rekomenduojame rinktis sustiprintas bazes – chromuotą metalą, dažytą metalą arba vientisą aliuminį. Visi jie skiriasi savo dizainu, todėl galima pasirinkti tą dizainą, kuris labiausiai atitiktų ofiso interjerą.

Ratukų pasirinkimas arba kaip išsaugoti grindų paviršių

Svarbus dalykas renkantis kėdę yra jos ratukai. Beveik visos kėdės pagal nutylėjimą turi plastikinius ratukus, kurie tinka minkštoms grindų dangoms (kilimui ar linoleumui). Jei kėdę naudosite ant keraminių plytelių, parketo ar laminato, būtinai paprašykite pakeisti savo ratukus guminiais. Tokie ratukai veikia tyliau ir daug mažiau gadina grindų paviršių. Taip pat galimas universalus sprendimas grindų apsaugai ir tylai darbo metu – plastikinis kilimėlis.

Biuro kėdės apmušalų pasirinkimas

Rekomenduojame atkreipti dėmesį į medžiagų atsparumo trinčiai rodiklį („Martindale“ testas). Tai yra specialiai audinių pramonei sukurtas  medžiagos dilimo testas. Kuo aukštesnis „Martindale“ įvertinimas, tuo ilgiau tarnaus kėdės apmušalas. Duomenis apie atsparumą rasite apmušalų kataloge arba visada galite pasikonsultuoti su profesionalais. Daugiau informacijos apie medžiagų atsparumą ir testavimus galima rasti statybajums.lt >>>

Ilgai naudojamoms biuro kėdėms rekomenduojame rinktis sintetinius arba pusiau sintetinius audinius, pasižyminčius aukštu ,,Martindale“ rodikliu.

Patvariausia medžiaga, žinoma, yra natūrali oda. Jis tarnaus daug kartų ilgiau nei kitos medžiagos. Be to, odinius gaminius galima restauruoti. Vienintelis natūralios odos trūkumas yra didelė kaina. Bet baldų apmušalų rinka nuolat vystosi, o audinių gamintojai kasdien stengiasi pagerinti savo gaminių atsparumą, kokybę ir asortimentą. Todėl yra sukurta daugybė odos imitacijų. Šie odos pakaitalai yra vadinami EKO oda. Kokybiškos EKO odos gamybos procese ant medvilnės pagrindo specialiu porėtu būdu padengiama vinilo danga. Tokia EKO oda daug geriau praleidžia orą ir pašalina drėgmę nei tikra oda ir kiti pakaitalai. Tačiau EKO odos medžiaga yra jautresnė mechaniniams pažeidimams ir dilimui. Taip pat galima alternatyva – sintetinė vinilo oda. Ji tarnauja daug ilgiau ir kainuoja pigiau, tačiau nepraleidžia drėgmės. Sintetinė vinilo oda rekomenduojama kėdėms su nedideliu sąlyčio su kūnu plotu. Pagrindinis tokios medžiagos privalumas yra šlapio valymo galimybė. Būtent todėl vinilinę dirbtinę odą rekomenduojame rinktis medicinos įstaigoms, maitinimo įstaigoms, virtuvėms ir laukimo patalpoms.

Kam skirta biuro kėdė?

Renkantis ofiso kėdę svarbu, kokį vaidmenį atlieka žmogus, kuriam ši kėdė skirta. Pagal šį kriterijų galime suskirstyti į kelias kategorijas:

Vadovų kėdės. Pagrindinė charakteristika renkantis tokią kėdę yra jos dizainas, t.y. reprezentatyvi išvaizda. Ji turėtų derėti prie interjero, taip pat pabrėžti jo savininko statusą ir stilių. Šios kategorijos kėdės turi daugiausia reguliavimo galimybių ir gali būti pritaikomos bet kuriam vartotojui pagal poreikį.

Kompiuterinės kėdės, personalo kėdės – tai pati plačiausia biuro kėdžių kategorija, o jų kainų diapazonas taip pat labai platus. Tokių kėdžių kaina prasideda nuo minimumo ir gali būti daug didesnė nei kai kurių vadovų kėdžių. Svarbiausias kriterijus renkantis tokią kėdę – galimybė ją pritaikyti konkrečiam vartotojui, o tai ypač svarbu, kai biuro kėdės perkamos vienodos visiems darbuotojams.

Kėdės lankytojams. Pagrindinė jų užduotis – priimti lankytojus. O atsižvelgiant į tai, kad vartotojų gali būti daug ir labai įvairių, pirmiausia reikėtų atkreipti dėmesį į kėdės konstrukcijos ir jos apmušalų tvirtumą. Apmušalai turi būti lengvai valomi ir atsparūs dilimui. Ypatingą dėmesį reiktų skirti direktoriaus kabineto lankytojų kėdėms. Dauguma gamintojų gamina kėdes lankytojams to paties dizaino kaip ir vadovo kėdė.

Kėdės barams, kavinėms ar virtuvėms. Dėl didelių eksploatacinių apkrovų jie turi atitikti itin didelius rėmo tvirtumo ir medžiagos atsparumo dilimui reikalavimus. Apmušalai turi būti lengvai valomi.

Kompiuterinės kėdės, personalo kėdės – tai pati plačiausia biuro kėdžių kategorija, o jų kainų diapazonas taip pat labai platus. Tokių kėdžių kaina prasideda nuo minimumo ir gali būti daug didesnė nei kai kurių vadovų kėdžių. Svarbiausias kriterijus renkantis tokią kėdę – galimybė ją pritaikyti konkrečiam vartotojui, o tai ypač svarbu, kai biuro kėdės perkamos vienodos visiems darbuotojams. Kėdės lankytojams. Pagrindinė jų užduotis – priimti lankytojus. O atsižvelgiant į tai, kad vartotojų gali būti daug ir labai įvairių, pirmiausia reikėtų atkreipti dėmesį į kėdės konstrukcijos ir jos apmušalų tvirtumą. Apmušalai turi būti lengvai valomi ir atsparūs dilimui. Ypatingą dėmesį reiktų skirti direktoriaus kabineto lankytojų kėdėms. Dauguma gamintojų gamina kėdes lankytojams to paties dizaino kaip ir vadovo kėdė. Kėdės barams, kavinėms ar virtuvėms. Dėl didelių eksploatacinių apkrovų jie turi atitikti itin didelius rėmo tvirtumo ir medžiagos atsparumo dilimui reikalavimus. Apmušalai turi būti lengvai valomi. +37069199833 ergonomic@azprekyba.lt
